title: Health Resort west wing room 220 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks room 220 of the West wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort west wing room 220 key (W220 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium west wing room 220.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in the Quest I Need More Power when you don't have a Health Resort west wing room 219 key

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In a key rack in the unlocked villa

- In a shelf in the southern warehouse at the smuggler base.

- In a key rack in west wing room 202 at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack in the utility room next to west wing room 227 at the health resort.

- In the key rack near the central stairs on the second floor of the east wing at the health resort.

- On the floor below a key rack near the central stairs on the third floor of the east wing at the health resort.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The second floor, room 220 of the West Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- 2x Weapon box (6x2)
- 1x Wooden crate
- Loose loot (Valuables, Meds, Medical supplies, Currency)
